title: Detection of Conspiracy Theories Beyond Keyword Bias in German-Language Telegram Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of text classification models (supervised fine-tuned BERT and prompt-based LLMs like GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and Llama 2) on a German Telegram dataset collected without keyword filtering, to demonstrate that models can effectively detect conspiracy theories without relying on explicit signal words or token-level bias.
